word.definition: Dissonant typically describes music that is not in harmony, or sounds and notes that clash. In non-music contexts, dissonant describes things that clash by not being in agreement or by not fitting well together.

sports_fact.text: In 2024, Shohei Ohtani became the first player in MLB history with 50 home runs and 50 stolen bases in a season — he finished with 54 and 59.

quote.text: The great work of the present for every man, and every organization of men, who would improve social conditions, is the work of education — the propagation of ideas. It is only as it aids this that anything else can avail. And in this work every one who can think may aid — first by forming clear ideas himself, and then by endeavoring to arouse the thought of those with whom he comes in contact.
quote.author: Henry George
